// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  _variables.scss — COMPILE-TIME design tokens (the single source of truth).
//  $color-*/$space-*/$cms-* values exist ONLY here + _structure.scss; every
//  component stylesheet must consume the CSS custom properties emitted from
//  _structure.scss (var(--bg-primary) etc) — never these $ vars directly.
//  Scale: spacing follows Fibonacci; grid-max-area tracks the max content width.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/// Raw palette color — published as a --color-white-raw CSS var by _structure.scss
$color-white: #fff;
/// Raw palette color — published as a --color-black-raw CSS var by _structure.scss
$color-black: #262626;
/// Raw palette color — published as a --color-grey-raw CSS var by _structure.scss
$color-grey: #a79e9e;
/// Raw palette color — published as a --color-grey-2-raw CSS var by _structure.scss
$color-grey-2: #f0f0f0;
/// Raw palette color — published as a --color-grey-3-raw CSS var by _structure.scss
$color-grey-3: #515151;

/// Raw palette color — published as a --color-blue-raw CSS var by _structure.scss
$color-blue: #006ca6;

// CMS Admin Palette tokens
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-bg-darkest: #0b0c10;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-bg-dark: #1f2833;
/// Mid-dark panel — between bg-card and bg-darkest
$cms-bg-darker: #0f1319;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-bg-card: #131822;
/// Subtle dark-theme border for panels and dividers
$cms-border: #2a3a4a;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-text-primary: #e0e6ed;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-text-muted: #c5c6c7;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-text-subtle: #8892b0;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-accent: #66fcf1;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-accent-hover: #45a29e;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-accent-contrast: #0f8a84;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-badge-warn: #f39c12;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-badge-amber: #ffca28;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-badge-green: #2ecc71;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-error: #ff6b6b;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-danger: #ff4d4d;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-danger-dark: #cc0000;
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-card-max-width: to-rem(420px);
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-header-min-height: to-rem(70px);
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-dropdown-min-width: to-rem(230px);
/// CMS admin-chrome token — compile-time only (dark panel theme)
$cms-container-max-width: to-rem(1400px);

// Viewports
// @type pixels
// used for viewports
/// Watch OS viewport (272px ≈ the 40mm watch's css-pixel width)
$vw-272: 272px;
/// Iphone SE
$vw-320: 320px;
/// Iphone
$vw-375: 375px;
/// Phablet
$vw-414: 414px;
/// Mobile menu breakpoint
$vw-475: 475px;
/// Phablet
$vw-540: 540px;
/// IPad
$vw-768: 768px;
/// Tablet
$vw-960: 960px;
/// IPad
$vw-1024: 1024px;
/// HD
$vw-1280: 1280px;
/// HD
$vw-1360: 1360px;
/// HD
$vw-1440: 1440px;
/// HD
$vw-1560: 1560px;
/// HD
$vw-1680: 1680px;
/// FHD
$vw-1920: 1920px;
/// 2K
$vw-2560: 2560px;
/// 4K
$vw-3840: 3840px;
/// 5K
$vw-5120: 5120px;
/// 8K
$vw-7680: 7680px;
/// 10K
$vw-10240: 10240px;

// @type number
// used for conversions
/// Unitless viewport width for 272px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-272: 272;
/// Unitless viewport width for 320px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-320: 320;
/// Unitless viewport width for 375px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-375: 375;
/// Unitless viewport width for 414px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-414: 414;
/// Unitless viewport width for 540px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-540: 540;
/// Unitless viewport width for 768px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-768: 768;
/// Unitless viewport width for 960px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-960: 960;
/// Unitless viewport width for 1024px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-1024: 1024;
/// Unitless viewport width for 1280px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-1280: 1280;
/// Unitless viewport width for 1360px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-1360: 1360;
/// Unitless viewport width for 1440px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-1440: 1440;
/// Unitless viewport width for 1560px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-1560: 1560;
/// Unitless viewport width for 1680px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-1680: 1680;
/// Unitless viewport width for 1920px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-1920: 1920;
/// Unitless viewport width for 2560px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-2560: 2560;
/// Unitless viewport width for 3840px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-3840: 3840;
/// Unitless viewport width for 5120px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-5120: 5120;
/// Unitless viewport width for 7680px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-7680: 7680;
/// Unitless viewport width for 10240px — consumed by grid-max-area arithmetic
$un-10240: 10240;

/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 272px viewport step
$gap-272: 13;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 320px viewport step
$gap-320: 21;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 375px viewport step
$gap-375: 21;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 414px viewport step
$gap-414: 21;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 540px viewport step
$gap-540: 34;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 768px viewport step
$gap-768: 55;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 960px viewport step
$gap-960: 55;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 1024px viewport step
$gap-1024: 89;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 1280px viewport step
$gap-1280: 89;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 1440px viewport step
$gap-1440: 89;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 1680px viewport step
$gap-1680: 144;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 1920px viewport step
$gap-1920: 144;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 2560px viewport step
$gap-2560: 233;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 3840px viewport step
$gap-3840: 377;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 5120px viewport step
$gap-5120: 377;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 7680px viewport step
$gap-7680: 610;
/// Grid gutter (unitless px) at the 10240px viewport step
$gap-10240: 610;

// Max area of the grid
/// Max content width at the 272px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-272: $un-272 - $gap-272 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 320px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-320: $un-320 - $gap-320 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 375px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-375: $un-375 - $gap-375 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 414px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-414: $un-414 - $gap-414 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 540px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-540: $un-540 - $gap-540 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 768px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-768: $un-768 - $gap-768 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 960px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-960: $un-960 - $gap-960 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 1024px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-1024: $un-1024 - $gap-1024 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 1280px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-1280: $un-1280 - $gap-1280 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 1440px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-1440: $un-1440 - $gap-1440 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 1680px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-1680: $un-1680 - $gap-1680 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 1920px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-1920: $un-1920 - $gap-1920 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 2560px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-2560: $un-2560 - $gap-2560 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 3840px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-3840: $un-3840 - $gap-3840 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 5120px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-5120: $un-5120 - $gap-5120 * 2;
/// Max content width at the 7680px step (un − 2·gap)
$grid-max-area-7680: $un-7680 - $gap-7680 * 2;

// Single source of truth for the stepped content grid: step px → gutter px.
// %MAXAREA (content gutters) and the show-grid debug overlay BOTH iterate
// this map via the `grid-steps` mixin so the overlay can never drift from
// the real layout breakpoints — every $un-$step-… token pair listed here
// produces one media query at `min-width: ($step - 1)px`.
/// Stepped content-grid map: viewport step px → gutter px. Both %MAXAREA
/// and the show-grid overlay iterate this via the `grid-steps` mixin.
$grid-steps: (
  272: $gap-272,
  320: $gap-320,
  375: $gap-375,
  414: $gap-414,
  540: $gap-540,
  768: $gap-768,
  960: $gap-960,
  1024: $gap-1024,
  1280: $gap-1280,
  1440: $gap-1440,
  1680: $gap-1680,
  1920: $gap-1920,
  2560: $gap-2560,
  3840: $gap-3840,
  5120: $gap-5120,
  7680: $gap-7680,
);

// Design-grid column count per step — shown by the show-grid overlay.
/// Column-count map: viewport step → design-grid columns for that step.
$grid-cols: (
  272: 4,
  320: 4,
  375: 4,
  414: 4,
  540: 6,
  768: 8,
  960: 8,
  1024: 12,
  1280: 12,
  1440: 12,
  1680: 12,
  1920: 12,
  2560: 12,
  3840: 12,
  5120: 12,
  7680: 12,
);

// @type pixels
// used for media queries
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-320 − 1px; consumed by the layout-320 mixin
$bk-320: $vw-320 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-375 − 1px; consumed by the layout-375 mixin
$bk-375: $vw-375 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-414 − 1px; consumed by the layout-414 mixin
$bk-414: $vw-414 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-475 − 1px; consumed by the layout-475 mixin
$bk-475: $vw-475 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-540 − 1px; consumed by the layout-540 mixin
$bk-540: $vw-540 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-768 − 1px; consumed by the layout-768 mixin
$bk-768: $vw-768 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-960 − 1px; consumed by the layout-960 mixin
$bk-960: $vw-960 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-1024 − 1px; consumed by the layout-1024 mixin
$bk-1024: $vw-1024 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-1280 − 1px; consumed by the layout-1280 mixin
$bk-1280: $vw-1280 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-1360 − 1px; consumed by the layout-1360 mixin
$bk-1360: $vw-1360 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-1560 − 1px; consumed by the layout-1560 mixin
$bk-1560: $vw-1560 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-1440 − 1px; consumed by the layout-1440 mixin
$bk-1440: $vw-1440 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-1680 − 1px; consumed by the layout-1680 mixin
$bk-1680: $vw-1680 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-1920 − 1px; consumed by the layout-1920 mixin
$bk-1920: $vw-1920 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-2560 − 1px; consumed by the layout-2560 mixin
$bk-2560: $vw-2560 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-3840 − 1px; consumed by the layout-3840 mixin
$bk-3840: $vw-3840 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-5120 − 1px; consumed by the layout-5120 mixin
$bk-5120: $vw-5120 - 1px;
/// Media-query breakpoint — vw-7680 − 1px; consumed by the layout-7680 mixin
$bk-7680: $vw-7680 - 1px;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Spacing Scale — Fibonacci sequence
// Each variable name reflects its relative size in the design system.
// Values are unitless (used with to-rem() helper).
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Fib(0)  — no space
$space-none: 0;
/// Fib(1)  — hairline / 1px borders
$space-hairline: 1;
/// Fib(2)  — alias for hairline (same fib value)
$space-pixel: 1;
/// Alias  — thin borders (same as hairline, semantic clarity)
$space-3xs: 1;
/// Fib(3)  — 2px, micro gaps
$space-2xs: 2;
/// Fib(4)  — 3px, tiny nudges
$space-xs: 3;
/// Fib(5)  — 5px, small gaps
$space-sm: 5;
/// Fib(6)  — 8px, base unit
$space-md: 8;
/// Fib(7)  — 13px, standard padding
$space-lg: 13;
/// Fib(8)  — 21px, comfortable spacing
$space-xl: 21;
/// Fib(9)  — 34px, section inner padding
$space-2xl: 34;
/// Fib(10) — 55px, component spacing
$space-3xl: 55;
/// Fib(11) — 89px, section padding
$space-4xl: 89;
/// Fib(12) — 144px, hero / large blocks
$space-5xl: 144;
/// Fib(13) — 233px, content max-widths / large images
$space-6xl: 233;
/// Fib(14) — 377px, image sizes / layout widths
$space-7xl: 377;
/// Fib(15) — 610px, large layout columns
$space-8xl: 610;
/// Fib(16) — 987px, max content widths
$space-9xl: 987;
/// Fib(17) — 1597px, ultra-wide layout slots
$space-10xl: 1597;
// The scale intentionally ends at 10xl — 1597px already exceeds the widest
// content max-area, so fib(18)+ steps carried no consumers and were removed.

// Coverage-report palette — istanbul's semantic statuses re-tokenized so
// sanitized report payloads (docs portal .docs-html) follow the app theme
// instead of the report's baked light hexes. Published as --cov-* by
// structure/_tokens.scss; dark overrides in structure/_dark-mode.scss.
/// Light theme — istanbul's own dark red (low-status bar, chart border).
$cov-low-strong: #c21f39;
/// Light theme — istanbul's medium red cell fill (cstat/fstat misses).
$cov-low-mid: #f6c6ce;
/// Light theme — istanbul's light red row tint (low rows, cline-no).
$cov-low-soft: #fce1e5;
/// Light theme — istanbul's light green row tint (high rows, cline-yes).
$cov-high-soft: #e6f5d0;
/// Light theme — istanbul's medium green cell fill (cstat-yes).
$cov-high-mid: #a1d76a;
/// Light theme — istanbul's dark green (high-status bar, chart border).
$cov-high-strong: #4d9221;
/// Light theme — istanbul's light gold row tint (medium rows).
$cov-med-soft: #fff4c2;
/// Light theme — istanbul's gold (medium-status bar, chart border).
$cov-med-strong: #f9cd0b;
/// Light theme — istanbul's branch-miss yellow cell.
$cov-warn: #ffea00;
/// Light theme — istanbul's skipped-stat grey.
$cov-skip: #dddddd;
/// Light theme — istanbul's neutral line marker grey.
$cov-neutral: #eaeaea;
/// Light theme — istanbul's zebra stripe for even source lines.
$cov-stripe: #eeeeee;
/// Both themes — istanbul's missing-branch chip stays a dark slab.
$cov-missing-bg: #333333;
/// Light theme — istanbul's missing-branch ink (yellow on the dark slab).
$cov-missing-ink: #ffe600;
/// Light theme — istanbul's fraction chip background.
$cov-fraction-bg: #e8e8e8;
/// Light theme — istanbul's fraction chip ink.
$cov-fraction-ink: #555555;
/// Light theme — istanbul's table/grid border grey.
$cov-border: #bbbbbb;
/// Light theme — istanbul's link blue.
$cov-link: #0074d9;

/// Dark theme — low-status red brightened for dark surfaces.
$cov-low-strong-dark: #d84a60;
/// Dark theme — mid red cell fill deepened so dark text areas stay quiet.
$cov-low-mid-dark: #7a2530;
/// Dark theme — light red row tint → deep desaturated maroon.
$cov-low-soft-dark: #381318;
/// Dark theme — light green row tint → deep olive-black.
$cov-high-soft-dark: #14230d;
/// Dark theme — medium green cell fill.
$cov-high-mid-dark: #5d9435;
/// Dark theme — high-status green brightened for dark surfaces.
$cov-high-strong-dark: #8fd356;
/// Dark theme — light gold row tint → deep umber.
$cov-med-soft-dark: #2e280f;
/// Dark theme — medium-status gold dimmed for dark surfaces.
$cov-med-strong-dark: #d4ac09;
/// Dark theme — branch-miss yellow → deep mustard.
$cov-warn-dark: #8a7a00;
/// Dark theme — skipped-stat grey lifted above the black surface.
$cov-skip-dark: #3d3d3d;
/// Dark theme — neutral line marker.
$cov-neutral-dark: $color-black;
/// Dark theme — zebra stripe for even source lines.
$cov-stripe-dark: #141414;
/// Dark theme — missing-branch ink keeps the yellow signal on the slab.
$cov-missing-ink-dark: #ffe600;
/// Dark theme — fraction chip background.
$cov-fraction-bg-dark: #1e1e1e;
/// Dark theme — fraction chip ink.
$cov-fraction-ink-dark: #b8b1ac;
/// Dark theme — table/grid border.
$cov-border-dark: #3a3a3a;
/// Dark theme — link blue lifted for contrast on dark.
$cov-link-dark: #58a6ff;

// Coverage syntax palette — google-code-prettify token inks re-tokenized
// for both themes (the inlined prettify.css ships light-only colors).
/// Light theme — strings/attribute values.
$cov-syn-str: #008800;
/// Light theme — keywords/tags.
$cov-syn-kwd: #000088;
/// Light theme — comments (base.css's muted grey wins over prettify maroon).
$cov-syn-com: #999999;
/// Light theme — types/attrs/decls/vars.
$cov-syn-typ: #660066;
/// Light theme — literals.
$cov-syn-lit: #006666;
/// Light theme — punctuation/operators/closers.
$cov-syn-pun: #666600;
/// Light theme — function names.
$cov-syn-fun: #d40000;
/// Dark theme — strings.
$cov-syn-str-dark: #9ece6a;
/// Dark theme — keywords/tags.
$cov-syn-kwd-dark: #7aa2f7;
/// Dark theme — comments.
$cov-syn-com-dark: #8a8a8a;
/// Dark theme — types/attrs/decls/vars.
$cov-syn-typ-dark: #e0af68;
/// Dark theme — literals.
$cov-syn-lit-dark: #ff9e64;
/// Dark theme — punctuation.
$cov-syn-pun-dark: #9aa5ce;
/// Dark theme — function names.
$cov-syn-fun-dark: #f7768e;

// Z-indexes — layering system, every value declared once here
/// z-index layer — the scale is declared once here, in stacking order
$z-header: 50;
/// z-index layer — the scale is declared once here, in stacking order
$z-loader: 100;
/// Grid overlay, debug overlays
$z-overlay: 200;
/// Stats-for-nerds HUD
$z-hud: 500;
/// Modals, drawers
$z-modal: 1000;
/// Cookie banner
$z-cookies: 1000;
/// App-nav
$z-nav: 1100;
/// Top-level elements (dialogs)
$z-top: 9999;

// System monospace font stack — no external download required
/// Monospace stack — system fonts only, so no webfont download blocks paint.
$font-mono:
  'ui-monospace', 'SF Mono', 'SFMono-Regular', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', 'Ubuntu Mono',
  'Roboto Mono', monospace;

/// Damped-spring easing for hover morphs (mosaic tiles, related strips)
/// — a physical spring response (ζ=0.6, ~1.3 cycles) sampled at 4%
/// intervals into a CSS linear() easing: ~10% overshoot, one settle
/// lobe, lands exactly at 1. Browsers without linear() keep the
/// cubic-bezier fallback declared alongside it at each callsite.
$ease-spring: linear(
  0,
  0.047,
  0.163,
  0.315,
  0.479,
  0.636,
  0.775,
  0.889,
  0.976,
  1.038,
  1.078,
  1.098,
  1.104,
  1.1,
  1.089,
  1.075,
  1.059,
  1.044,
  1.031,
  1.02,
  1.012,
  1.006,
  1.002,
  1,
  1,
  1
);
